entries.reason: the array is the extension's own and the extension owns it: the port's NSExtensionContext already keeps state of its own, as registry/Foundation/ios8extensioncontext.json records
entries.effect: copied in and copied out, and an extension that set none reads an empty array rather than nil; the system that would draw those actions in the notification, and the response that would come back through -didReceiveNotificationResponse:completionHandler:, belong to the extension host this release does not run
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2; the release has no app extensions at all, read from the port's own facts/Foundation/NSExtensionContext.md

entries.reason: the action belongs to a notification the system delivered to an extension, and iOS 6 delivers no notification to an extension: there is no notification and no action to perform
entries.effect: does nothing, and says so once in the log the first time it is called - the same answer the port's NSExtensionContext already gives for completing a request, cancelling one and opening a URL
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2; facts/Foundation/NSExtensionContext.md

entries.reason: there is no content extension to dismiss: the release runs no extension host, and the port's NSExtensionContext holds no presented controller either
entries.effect: does nothing, and says so once in the log the first time it is called
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2; facts/Foundation/NSExtensionContext.md

entries.reason: it tells the system the extension's media has started, so the system can put playback controls in the notification and stop the sound with it; this release's system takes no playback controls in a notification, and there is no notification to take them in
entries.effect: the started state is kept on the context, and nothing is shown for it; says so once in the log the first time it is called
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2

entries.reason: the other half of the same message, and the same wall: what it would stop is a sound this release's system never started for a notification
entries.effect: the paused state is kept on the context, and nothing is stopped for it; says so once in the log the first time it is called
entries.source: the header of UNNotificationContentExtension.h in SDK 26.2
